:::{#sol-cross-entropy-numeric-definition-compare}

The [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) equals $\E{-\log_2 q_X}$.
The two calculations group the same three terms differently:
the [expectation](#def-expectation) first combines [outcomes](probability-basics.qmd#def-experiment-outcome) 1 and 3, which have the same value of $-\log_2 q_X$.

:::
